verdict.rationale: Claude Code doesn't document a native webhook-subscription feature, but evidence shows it can react to webhook events indirectly: an MCP server can 'push messages into your session ... so Claude reacts to ... webhook events while you're away' and 'Routines' can be triggered 'from an API call, or in response to an event'. This is indirect, third-party-server-mediated support rather than a first-class webhook subscription API. Missing for 10: a dedicated first-party webhook endpoint/subscription mechanism, documentation of setup/auth for webhook triggers, and independent confirmation of this working in practice.
